reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. In my reply I also warned her about two lookalikes: #88412 is an old 2025 Tansleigh Packaging ticket, and #4409/#4412 are older Marrow Fieldworks tickets from the January handoff.

One thing to know: Tobias didn't actually name Marrow Fieldworks. He called it his "dealer account" (the Plains depots). Marrow Fieldworks is the dealer account that changed hands in January, so it's almost certainly the same account, but that's my inference. My reply to Pree says "at Marrow Fieldworks" as if it were confirmed. There are no Marrow ticket files in the share I could check it against.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public team files.
